title: SMProfile-JobResponse payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/job-response.json 1.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

job_response_id.description: Identity of the job response: its own number from the source system (MES). It is never built from other keys.

work_response_ref.description: The work response this job response is part of (PART_OF).

job_order_ref.description: The job order this response answers (RESPONDS_TO).

work_master_ref.description: The work master the job ran by (FOR_WORK_MASTER).

machine_ref.description: The machine (Equipment) the job ran on (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT).

material_lot_ref.description: The lot the job consumed or produced (ACTUAL_MATERIAL).

tool_ref.description: The tool (physical asset) the job used (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET).

person_ref.description: The person who ran the job (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL) — the pseudonymous person_id, never a name.

status.description: Job state as the source names it (ISA-95 JobState).
